shots.beat: A living specimen answers a four-tap rhythm behind real glass.
Petrov approaches and physically taps the vessel four times.
The specimen repeats the rhythm; Petrov recognizes the response.
Vale dismisses the response; Petrov turns to challenge him.
One culture pinches into two synchronized, independently moving bodies.
A living filament touches the worker wrist; he recoils and collapses while Petrov intervenes.
Mechanical restraint closes; Petrov returns to the familiar rhythm.
Vale secretly releases a physical interlock; the hatch opens and the culture finds a floor drain.
The culture crawls through a lit corrugated service duct, leaving a wet trace.
The creature squeezes through a real street grate into a wet, inhabited city alley.
Ordinary people pass beyond the alley as the creature chooses its next movement; gameplay receives control afterward.
